description: Source-pinned probes for flat and belt brim range geometry. Baseline and restored 50-case controls pass; all three probes are killed by ordinary assertions.

mutants.description: Preserve the 0 and 5 mm controls but truncate the registered 100 mm maximum; the actual outer emitted-path clearance must remain near 100 mm on all four sides.

Ignore the belt leading-length consumer; default and explicit-zero rows must still emit no brim. Positive 5 and 100 mm rows are measured against an otherwise identical extra-width=5 mm anchor, cancelling the fixture/contact-boundary offset; both true configured distances must be recovered from the 45-degree projected belt metric.
Ignore the cross-belt consumer; left and right emitted path reaches must each match 5 and 100 mm, with no corresponding change along the belt-feed axis.
